description: This file provides utilities for wrapping and handling 'direct' functions that interact with Large Language Models (LLMs). It includes classes to extract metadata from function signatures and docstrings, validate functions, and convert functions into schemas suitable for LLM calls. The main classes are Protocol for defining the expected structure of such functions, and wrapper classes that facilitate metadata extraction and invocation.

classes.name: DirectFunction
classes.description: A Protocol defining the interface for a 'direct' function that handles LLM function calls. It requires an async __call__ method accepting FunctionCallParams and additional kwargs.

classes.name: BaseDirectFunctionWrapper
classes.description: A base class for wrapping a 'direct' function, providing metadata extraction from the function's signature and docstring, and conversion into a FunctionSchema.

classes.name: DirectFunctionWrapper
classes.description: A subclass of BaseDirectFunctionWrapper tailored for functions where the first parameter is named 'params'. It includes an invoke method to call the wrapped function with arguments and params.

methods.name: str special_first_param_name(cls)
methods.description: Returns the name of the special first parameter expected by the wrapper classes. For BaseDirectFunctionWrapper, it is not implemented; for DirectFunctionWrapper, it returns 'params'.

methods.name: None validate_function(cls, function: Callable)
methods.description: Validates that the provided function is asynchronous, has at least one parameter, and that the first parameter's name matches the expected special name.

methods.name: FunctionSchema to_function_schema(self)
methods.description: Converts the wrapper's function into a FunctionSchema, encapsulating the metadata.

methods.name: _initialize_metadata(self)
methods.description: Extracts and initializes metadata (name, description, parameters) from the wrapped function.

methods.name: Tuple[Dict[str,Any],List[str]] _get_parameters_as_jsonschema( self, func: Callable, docstring_params: List[docstring_parser.DocstringParam] )
methods.description: Extracts function parameters as a JSON schema dictionary and list of required field names, ignoring the first 'special' parameter.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _typehint_to_jsonschema(self, type_hint: Any)
methods.description: Converts Python type hints into JSON schema fragment dictionaries.

methods.name: invoke(self, args: Mapping[str, Any], params: "FunctionCallParams")
methods.description: Asynchronously calls the wrapped function with provided arguments and FunctionCallParams.

ctags.name: invoke
ctags.pattern: /^    async def invoke(self, args: Mapping[str, Any], params: "FunctionCallParams"):$/
